why: §12.3 of the plan settled that a phone number is validated CONTENT, not code and not an environment variable, and the cost of getting it wrong is documented in Galegos itself: PR `Navesz/Galegos#1` tried to move the number into an env var and the owner stopped the PR, because the build passes, the deploy goes up and `wa.me` generates a link with no recipient. The rule became deterministic with one true and zero false positives across 417 measured code files. Both sides have the SAME number written the SAME way: on the `pass` side it is in a COMMENT and on `fail` in a constant the program uses. A comment does not go up in `wa.me`, and a ruler that accused comments would accuse the very note that explains it — which is what happened in this repository while this rule was being written.
